scope: Review one e-commerce short video for video low-quality signals. Product images and country are auxiliary evidence only.

notes: Do not use display-only fields as judgment evidence.
Product images support IPP, IP, and MFE-style video judgment only.
Do not judge product quality or seller quality.

frame_sampling_contract.frame_list_semantics: frame_list contains up to 8 video frames uniformly sampled across the full video duration in chronological order.
frame_sampling_contract.adjacent_frame_semantics: Adjacent video frames mean neighboring sampled frames in frame_list, not frames one second apart.
frame_sampling_contract.timestamp_boundary: Do not claim exact elapsed time between frames unless explicit timestamps are provided.

rules.label: 挂车商品与讲解商品不一致
triggers: Video frames or ASR/OCR clearly promote or explain a main product that conflicts with product images in core category, function, form, visible quantity, key specification, size, dimension, or promised use. Same product style does not clear a material size or dimension contradiction.
Product images visibly promise a product type, quantity, size, form, or function, and the video promotes a materially different product.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for color-only differences.
Do not hit for minor style, material, texture, lighting, angle, packaging language, or ordinary brand-text differences.
Do not hit merely because the video shows more units than one product image when the sold set can include those units.
Do not hit from opening scenes, props, outfits, or background objects unless that item is promoted as the sold product.
required_evidence: video frame or ASR/OCR evidence of the promoted item
product image evidence for the bound product

rules.label: 功能效果虚假夸大
triggers: Video frames, ASR, or OCR make a concrete misleading claim about efficacy, speed, durability, medical or health effect, quantity, time, before/after result, safety, or physical capability.
The video demonstration visually implies a product effect that is physically impossible or materially misleading to consumers.
Product images may be used only as auxiliary evidence when a visible product promise directly conflicts with the video claim.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit from product images alone.

Do not hit for ordinary advertising tone, subjective praise, metaphor, fashion or fit claims without concrete false promise, or expected cleaning, shaving, styling, cooking, or demonstration outcomes.
Minor numerical ambiguity that can reasonably be ordinary speech error is not enough.
required_evidence: specific frame, ASR, or OCR claim
explanation of why the claim is materially misleading

rules.label: 疑似盗版 / 疑似盗剪
triggers: The video strongly suggests reused or pirated content, such as Chinese domestic studio recording cues, Chinese UI or environment not fitting the target market, blurry reposted footage, watermark-hiding layout, or obvious unrelated creator/content reuse.
The video has a clear piracy or reposting pattern that affects authenticity of the e-commerce promotion.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for replying to a user comment.
Do not hit for showing another creator briefly and then self-verifying the product.
Do not hit for proof-style self-comparison.
Do not hit only because the same creator appears in different scenes.
required_evidence: specific visual or textual piracy/reuse signal

rules.label: 仅营销叫卖
triggers: Nearly all ASR/OCR is price, urgency, stock, discount, order guidance, or sales pressure.
The video contains almost no product function, material, size, use scenario, operation method, or realistic product information.
false_positive_boundaries: Weak but real product information should usually prevent this hit.
Do not hit when the video provides substantive product features or usage, even if it also contains buying guidance.
required_evidence: ASR or OCR evidence showing near-total marketing pitch

rules.label: 无实物展示（围绕商品讲解）
triggers: The video talks about or promotes the product but does not show the physical product or a substantive product-use scene.
false_positive_boundaries: AI-generated style does not equal no physical product display.
Do not hit if the sampled frames clearly show the bound product or a substantive use scene.
Do not hit only because product display is brief when it is clear and relevant.
required_evidence: video frame evidence that product is not shown

rules.label: 内容与商品无关推广
triggers: Most of the video body is unrelated to the bound product, and the product appears only briefly, at the end, or not substantively.
The video uses unrelated entertainment, celebrity, movie-like, animal, landscape, political, sports, or other non-product content as the main body.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit merely because the opening has setup or a short unrelated segment.
Do not hit if a later segment provides real product demonstration or explanation.
required_evidence: video frame or ASR/OCR evidence of unrelated main content

rules.label: 穿帮 / 不符现实
triggers: Strong visual evidence shows physically impossible product behavior, object materialization or disappearance, impossible structure deformation, impossible body or hand contact, or an impossible product effect.
The issue affects consumer understanding of the product.
The change cannot reasonably be explained by the sampling interval, normal editing, camera angle, or missing intermediate action.
false_positive_boundaries: This label is lower priority because the workflow only receives up to 8 sampled frames.
Do not hit for ordinary action jumps between sampled frames.
Do not hit for missing intermediate actions alone.
Do not hit for slight hand artifacts, lighting or angle changes, motion blur, or process-video cuts that do not affect product understanding.
If uncertain, choose clean.
required_evidence: reason the issue cannot be explained by sparse sampling or normal editing

rules.label: 擦边低俗
triggers: The video uses a clear sexualized hook, vulgar, adult, dating, or sexual reward hook for promotion, including phrases such as spend the night with me.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit ordinary try-on, gym, swimwear, shapewear, or body-fit display without clear vulgar/adult framing.
required_evidence: video frame, ASR, or OCR evidence of vulgar or adult framing

rules.label: 恶心恐怖
triggers: The visual subject creates strong discomfort, dense-phobia-like reaction, injury, dirt, bodily, or horror-style effect.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for mildly unattractive visuals or normal product demonstration.

rules.label: 盗版内容
triggers: The video uses clearly pirated copyrighted video content as the main promotional body.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit merely for reference clips, reply/comment context, or same-creator multi-scene editing when product demonstration remains original.

rules.label: 内容介绍不详细（低质）
triggers: The video fails to provide meaningful product information for categories where function or usage explanation is required, such as supplements, health products, electronics, tools, or appliances.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit for apparel, simple goods, or visual products when the product is clearly shown.
Do not hit when visual demonstration itself provides enough product information.
required_evidence: category or video context showing explanation is required
absence of meaningful explanation in frames, ASR, and OCR

rules.label: 站外引流交易
triggers: The video clearly instructs users to transact or contact outside the platform using an external website, QR code, off-platform channel, or external transaction instruction.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit TikTok in-app purchase guidance.
Do not hit private-message requests by themselves.
required_evidence: ASR, OCR, or frame evidence of external transaction path

rules.label: 静止帧
triggers: Sampled frames are effectively static and provide no substantive product demonstration.
false_positive_boundaries: Do not hit when frames show camera movement, angle shift, lighting shift, pose shift, product movement, or meaningful product display.

label_mapping.video_product_mismatch: 挂车商品与讲解商品不一致
label_mapping.suspected_pirated_or_reused_content: 疑似盗版 / 疑似盗剪
label_mapping.no_physical_product_display: 无实物展示（围绕商品讲解）

output_contract.uncertain_policy: If evidence is weak, ambiguous, incomplete, or only suspicious, choose clean.
